reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week, the weeks of 6 January to 31 March 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS week_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-04-07', INTERVAL 7 DAY)
), weekly AS (
  -- one row per week with signups
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-06 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-07 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('week', signup_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(s.signups, 0) AS signups
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly s ON s.week_start = w.week_start

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS week_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-03-31', INTERVAL 7 DAY) t(d)
), s AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-06 00:00:00'
    AND (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-07 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(s.signups, 0) AS signups
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN s ON s.week_start = w.week_start
